stages.name: implement
stages.description: Implements every story in a folder headlessly: a worktree and branch per story, the implementer agent, then the review and QE stages

stages.name: review
stages.description: Architecture review of the implementation, looping with the implementation agent until approved

stages.name: qe
stages.description: Verified test plans from stories and verified automated tests once the review approves

stages.name: pr-check
stages.description: Adversarial PR check against the story (acceptance criteria, flow, UI design, style, video): from the Stop hook once QE has verified the tests (findings go back to the agent), or on demand with a fix loop to 10/10
